notes: Every s### and t### partitioned exactly once.

The two English *how*s are distinguished: the expressed πῶς takes the main-clause one, and the supplied one introducing the infinitival complement belongs to προστῆναι under rule 85. Rule 86 does not make it `added`, an infinitive being a source token that carries the subordination.
τοῦ is `unrepresented` because ἴδιος takes *his own* before an expressed head noun (rules 20, 47), analysed identically to 1TI.3.4 and 1TI.3.12.
ἐκκλησίας is anarthrous, so both the supplied determiner and the case preposition are rule 7/21/51 helpers on the noun; θεοῦ has no determiner and keeps its bare *of* under rule 21.
ἐπιμελήσεται → *shall he take care* heads on the meaning-bearing complement *care* under rule 17.
